scope: Grouped remaining work for the full security plan, including current D/N/M/W source/local verification; no production certification
counting_rule: 14 uniquely numbered implementation package identities and 6 acceptance/rollout gate identities; finding mappings overlap and must not be summed as separate implementations. Source implemented does not mean deployed.

implementation_packages.title: Versioned server encryption
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Finish the encryption/keyring bridge for approved phone/email/profile/raw-payload copies and IMAP secrets: parallel storage, transactional writes, bounded backfill, verified reads and retained original keys.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Complete the P2 format transition and a different-host restore without plaintext downgrade, changed IDs or lost old-key readability.

implementation_packages.title: Encrypted device database and receipts
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Finish native key custody, resumable SQLite/receipt conversion, the complete writer inventory and remaining crash/power-loss repair. Existing account recovery and receipt reconciliation are foundations; live encryption remains off.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Fresh/upgrade/offline/account-switch/key-loss/interruption/low-disk behavior preserves pending data and receipts, without a new password.

implementation_packages.title: Remaining database privilege repair
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Extend reviewed repairs for remaining PUBLIC/default/inherited grants, ownership/RLS and unsafe definer paths; audit the actual restored role matrix. The narrow exact-grant tool already exists.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Strict actual-role reports pass while ordinary application and worker requests retain required access.

implementation_packages.title: Business-aware data reconciliation
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Reconcile historical cap/benefit IDs and state, then rehearse the new additive normalized uniqueness on the current clone; review every collision before activation.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Before/after IDs, counts, amounts, cap usage, benefit usage and foreign keys reconcile; non-equivalent rows are retained.

implementation_packages.title: Index reconciliation
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Compare the overlapping indexes and query plans, then apply only reviewed remove/retain decisions. Keep backing uniqueness constraints.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Constraint coverage and representative query performance are preserved on the reviewed target.

implementation_packages.title: Cross-store retention and lifecycle privacy
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Finish the approved OTP/refresh/audit/raw-import/cursor/attachment retention categories and missing bounded jobs. Existing deletion ledgers and selected retention jobs stay intact.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Replay detection, long-offline recovery, financial history and restore tombstones survive bounded cleanup.

implementation_packages.title: Durable customer notification delivery
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Add a transactional pending-delivery outbox for important inbox/business notifications, with bounded claims, retries and terminal failure handling. Existing reward/referral outboxes and the new operator adapter do not close this gap.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: A crash after commit or an uncertain provider response cannot silently lose a required delivery or duplicate its financial effect.

implementation_packages.title: Clock-independent offline conflicts
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Replace authoritative phone-wall-clock ordering with reviewed server revisions or logical ordering while preserving losing values and conflict visibility.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Wrong device dates, concurrent edits, edit/delete races and long-offline re-entry reconcile without lost mutations.

implementation_packages.title: Remaining shared abuse controls
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Complete durable multi-instance admission for general/user/admin route classes; hosted OTP/enumeration/replacement quotas already use PostgreSQL.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Two instances, restart, exhaustion and store outage cannot accidentally permit unlimited sensitive requests.

implementation_packages.title: Operation-specific administrator permissions
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Define and enforce narrower reviewer/publisher/support/export powers, recent-factor requirements and separation for high-impact actions.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Unprivileged or narrower operators cannot self-approve, escalate or invoke unrelated high-impact actions.

implementation_packages.title: Reliability metrics and independent monitoring
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Add privacy-preserving trends, service objectives, backlog/cleanup/backup-age thresholds and missing-run detection. The optional notice webhook adapter already exists.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Injected outages, stale backups and stopped jobs produce useful signals accepted by an accountable operator.

implementation_packages.title: Large-import continuation and provider backpressure
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Finish durable large-work continuation, per-account/provider concurrency and quota handling, with fair admission across pools. Existing selected IMAP/SMTP/export bounds remain.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Slow or throttled integrations and burst backlogs do not starve sign-in or small financial writes.

implementation_packages.title: Historical financial reproducibility
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Complete ruleset/parser/calculation versioning and auditable reconciliation for historical estimates and recalculations; shared Dart/Node parity fixtures already exist.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Edits, refunds, period changes and replay explain the original result and any revised result without silently rewriting history.

implementation_packages.title: Compatibility, configuration and reviewed cleanup
implementation_packages.remaining_work: Complete API/feature/version configuration consolidation, route-preserving domain extraction, reviewed legacy consumer/package/repository retirement and matching documentation. Six-digit clients and retirement switches already exist.
implementation_packages.completion_criterion: Supported clients retain contracts; legacy storage/code is retired only after consumer and recovery evidence, or retained with an explicit reviewed decision.

release_gates.title: Signed mobile and native acceptance
release_gates.remaining_work: Validate the actual Android/iOS release packages, signing/upgrade compatibility, hardware-backed key behavior, TLS, permissions, shrinking/Room paths and full device-loss/crash matrix. Three isolated Android component checks have passed.

release_gates.title: Providers, browser and supported clients
release_gates.remaining_work: Verify real email/SMS/Google and optional integrations, browser cookies/CSRF/CSP/proxy/operator flows, current/oldest supported clients, and the monitored legacy-route retirement window.

release_gates.title: Actual-data PostgreSQL migration and failback
release_gates.remaining_work: Run this exact candidate on a complete current restored copy and intended PostgreSQL provider. Apply reviewed contact/role/data changes, preserve all original keys and IDs, then prove cutover and post-write failback/replay.

release_gates.title: Independent backup and journal custody
release_gates.remaining_work: Provision and verify two off-host encrypted recovery copies in separate failure domains, an independently retained latest lifecycle checkpoint and separate recovery-key custody. One Mac and its shortcut count as one location.

release_gates.title: Release security, contract and load evidence
release_gates.remaining_work: Finish full history/native artifact secret review, Dart/native dependency checks, broader payload/relationship tests, historical financial parity, actual deployed-tree verification and representative failure/load runs.

release_gates.title: Monitored operations and controlled rollout
release_gates.remaining_work: Approve retention policies and measured free-host quotas, replace old cron in a fenced activation, configure scheduler/independent monitor/receiver and accepted alert routing, then freeze evidence and perform the separately approved rollout/failback procedure.
